name: Grok Build
description: xAI's Grok Build CLI, headless: one grok process per turn, resumed into a single session. Experimental first slice.

model.title: Orchestrator model
model.description: Model for the colony as xai-grok/<model> (grok-4.5 is the CLI's own default) or a bare xAI model id. A <provider>/<model> whose prefix matches a connection from Settings → Model providers rides the mothership's gateway on its openai wire instead — tokens and spend are accounted host-side. Anthropic-wire connections and providers with no route are refused: grok speaks the OpenAI wire only.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools
disabled_tools.description: Comma-separated Grok Build tool ids this colony never gets, passed as grok's headless --disallowed-tools denylist, such as run_terminal_cmd, write_file or web_fetch. web_search is always off already (the runner passes --disable-web-search) and the colonizer MCP tools are not covered by the denylist. Empty disables nothing.
